reason: Wrong vertical and wrong problem: Cellanome is a Foster City, CA Series B life-science instrumentation company (~104 employees, $213.75M raised, live-cell imaging + single-cell transcriptomics) — not a $2M-$20M low-voltage integrator, electrical contractor, or building-technology vendor; its entire live job list (Director of Corporate & Business Development, Director of Segment Marketing & Market Development, Research Associate 2 Services, Scientist I, Staff Scientist Chemistry) is biotech commercial and wet-lab hiring, and no posting contains a line about vendor selection, estimating, managed Wi-Fi/surveillance/access control, service plans, or recurring revenue, so there is no quotable evidence of the pain David Shake fixes.
